## Important Details
- Repo root: `C:\Users\USER\Documents\project\ezeay\ezeay`; server is a nested `tsx` package in `server/`.
- DB is Neon and push-managed. Do **not** run `drizzle/0010_sweet_moira_mactaggert.sql`; it contains stale-snapshot creates. `lesson_scripts` DDL was applied directly.
- `.gitignore` ignores `*.json`; existing snapshots `0000`–`0009` were force-added earlier.
- `.env` lacks `CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET`, `CLOUDINARY_API_KEY`, `CLOUDINARY_AUDIO_UPLOAD_PRESET`, `TTS_MODEL`, and `TTS_VOICE`; defaults are used.
- Cloudinary audio uses unsigned preset via `/video/upload` with `Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded`; derived MP3 delivery works through `f_mp3`.
- TTS verified: `gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts`, voice `Kore`, `audio/L16;codec=pcm;rate=24000`.
- MathJax SVGs use root `width`/`height` in `ex`, `viewBox`, `currentColor`, `<defs>` + `<use>`. Client strips fixed dimensions and replaces `currentColor` with theme text color.
- `expo-audio` API: `useAudioPlayer(undefined)`, `useAudioPlayerStatus(player)`, `replace(url)`, `play()`, `pause()`, `seekTo(seconds)`; status includes `isLoaded`, `playing`, `currentTime`/`duration` in seconds, `didJustFinish`.
- Audio mode set with `{ playsInSilentMode: true, shouldPlayInBackground: false, allowsRecording: false, interruptionMode: "duckOthers" }`.
- Stale `didJustFinish` guarded by `activeClipRef`, `finishedClipRef`, and an 800 ms `clipStartedAtRef` cooldown.
- TTS is not generated on mount; first play generates missing audio with spinner and server timeout `180_000`. Manual reading remains possible.
- Narration auto-advances on audio completion; checkpoint slides do not advance and scroll to the checkpoint instead. Checkpoints block Next until solved.
- Explain responses are cached per `lessonId:slideId:action`; explain modal request races are guarded by `explainRequestRef`.
- New route is not in generated `.expo/types/router.d.ts`; chapter navigation uses an object cast as `unknown as Href`.
- Validator clamps diagram coordinates to `0..100`; renderer uses a `0 0 100 60` viewBox with short SVG labels.

import { mathjax } from "mathjax-full/js/mathjax.js";
import { TeX } from "mathjax-full/js/input/tex.js";
import { SVG } from "mathjax-full/js/output/svg.js";
import { liteAdaptor } from "mathjax-full/js/adaptors/liteAdaptor.js";
import { RegisterHTMLHandler } from "mathjax-full/js/handlers/html.js";

const MAX_LATEX_LENGTH = 400;
const MAX_SVG_LENGTH = 200_000;
const CACHE_LIMIT = 200;

const UNSAFE_LATEX =
  /\\(?:href|url|style|class|cssId|htmlId|require|includegraphics|def|newcommand|renewcommand|input|include|csname|futurelet|afterassignment)\b/i;

const UNSAFE_SVG = /<script|javascript:|<foreignObject|\son[a-z]+\s*=/i;

export class MathRenderError extends Error {
  constructor(message = "Unable to render equation") {
    super(message);
    this.name = "MathRenderError";
  }
}

const adaptor = liteAdaptor();
RegisterHTMLHandler(adaptor);

const tex = new TeX({
  packages: ["base", "ams", "color", "cancel", "noundefined", "noerrors"],
});
const svg = new SVG({ fontCache: "local" });
const document = mathjax.document("", { InputJax: tex, OutputJax: svg });

const cache = new Map<string, string>();

function remember(key: string, value: string): string {
  if (cache.size >= CACHE_LIMIT) {
    const oldest = cache.keys().next().value;
    if (oldest !== undefined) cache.delete(oldest);
  }
  cache.set(key, value);
  return value;
}

export function latexToSvg(latex: string, display = true): string {
  if (typeof latex !== "string") throw new MathRenderError("Empty LaTeX");
  const input = latex.trim();
  if (!input) throw new MathRenderError("Empty LaTeX");
  if (input.length > MAX_LATEX_LENGTH) {
    throw new MathRenderError("Equation is too long");
  }
  if (UNSAFE_LATEX.test(input)) {
    throw new MathRenderError("Equation contains an unsafe command");
  }

  const cacheKey = `${display ? "d" : "i"}:${input}`;
  const hit = cache.get(cacheKey);
  if (hit) {
    cache.delete(cacheKey);
    cache.set(cacheKey, hit);
    return hit;
  }

  let output = "";
  try {
    const node = document.convert(input, { display });
    const html = adaptor.outerHTML(node);
    const match = html.match(/<svg[\s\S]*?<\/svg>/i);
    output = match ? match[0] : "";
  } catch (err) {
    throw new MathRenderError(
      err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unable to render equation",
    );
  }

  if (!output) throw new MathRenderError("MathJax returned no SVG");
  output = output.replace(/\sxlink:href=/g, " href=");
  if (output.length > MAX_SVG_LENGTH) {
    throw new MathRenderError("Rendered equation is too large");
  }
  if (UNSAFE_SVG.test(output)) {
    throw new MathRenderError("Rendered equation contains unsafe markup");
  }

  return remember(cacheKey, output);
}

  "/api/courses/:id/lessons/:chapterIndex/:subtopicIndex",
  async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const claims = await verifyClerkToken(req.headers.authorization);
      const chapterIndex = parseLessonIndex(req.params.chapterIndex);
      const subtopicIndex = parseLessonIndex(req.params.subtopicIndex);
      if (chapterIndex === null || subtopicIndex === null) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: "Invalid chapter or subtopic index" });
        return;
      }

      const access = await getCourseAccess(req.params.id, claims.sub);
      if (access.status === "not_found") {
        res.status(404).json({ error: "Course not found" });
        return;
      }
      if (access.status === "forbidden") {
        res.status(403).json({ error: "This course is private" });
        return;
      }

      const source = resolveLessonSource(
        access.course,
        chapterIndex,
        subtopicIndex,
      );
      if (!source) {
        res.status(404).json({ error: "Chapter or subtopic not found" });
        return;
      }

      const [row] = await db
        .select()
        .from(lessonScripts)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(lessonScripts.courseId, access.course.id),
            eq(lessonScripts.chapterIndex, chapterIndex),
            eq(lessonScripts.subtopicIndex, subtopicIndex),
          ),
        )
        .limit(1);

      if (!row) {
        res
          .status(404)
          .json({ error: "Lesson not generated", code: "lesson_missing" });
        return;
      }

      if (
        row.sourceHash !==
        lessonHash(access.course, source.chapter, source.subtopic)
      ) {
        res

        return;
      }

      res.json(mapLessonRow(row));
    } catch (err) {
      if (isTokenError(err)) {
        res.status(401).json({ error: "Invalid token" });
        return;
      }
      sendRouteError(res, err, "[Server] GET lesson failed");
    }
  },
);

app.post(
  "/api/courses/:id/lessons/:chapterIndex/:subtopicIndex/generate",
  async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const claims = await verifyClerkToken(req.headers.authorization);
      const chapterIndex = parseLessonIndex(req.params.chapterIndex);
      const subtopicIndex = parseLessonIndex(req.params.subtopicIndex);
      if (chapterIndex === null || subtopicIndex === null) {
        res.status(400).json({ error: "Invalid chapter or subtopic index" });
        return;
      }

      const access = await getCourseAccess(req.params.id, claims.sub);
      if (access.status === "not_found") {
        res.status(404).json({ error: "Course not found" });
        return;
      }
      if (access.status === "forbidden") {
        res.status(403).json({ error: "This course is private" });
        return;
      }

      const source = resolveLessonSource(
        access.course,
        chapterIndex,
        subtopicIndex,
      );
      if (!source) {
        res.status(404).json({ error: "Chapter or subtopic not found" });
        return;
      }

      const sourceHash = lessonHash(
        access.course,
        source.chapter,
        source.subtopic,
      );

      const [existing] = await db
        .select()
        .from(lessonScripts)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(lessonScripts.courseId, access.course.id),
            eq(lessonScripts.chapterIndex, chapterIndex),
            eq(lessonScripts.subtopicIndex, subtopicIndex),
          ),
        )
        .limit(1);

      if (existing && existing.sourceHash === sourceHash) {
        res.json(mapLessonRow(existing));
        return;
      }

      const { modelRef, apiKey } = aiRequestOptions(req);
      const prompt = buildLessonScriptPrompt({
        courseTitle: access.course.title,
        chapterTitle: source.chapter.title,
        chapterDescription: source.chapter.description,
        difficulty: access.course.difficulty,
        subtopicTitle: source.subtopic.title,
        subtopicContent: source.subtopic.content,
        slideCount: 6,
      });

      const draft = await generateLessonScript(modelRef, prompt, apiKey);
      const script = attachEquationSvgs(draft);

      const [row] = await db
        .insert(lessonScripts)
        .values({
          id: `lsn_${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
          courseId: access.course.id,
          chapterIndex,
          subtopicIndex,
          title: script.title,
          script,
          audio: [],
          voice: TTS_VOICE,
          ttsModel: TTS_MODEL,
          sourceHash,
          status: "script_ready",
          version: 1,
        })
        .onConflictDoUpdate({
          target: [
            lessonScripts.courseId,
            lessonScripts.chapterIndex,
            lessonScripts.subtopicIndex,
          ],
          set: {
            title: script.title,
            script,
            audio: [],
            voice: TTS_VOICE,
            ttsModel: TTS_MODEL,
            sourceHash,
            status: "script_ready",
            version: drizzleSql`${lessonScripts.version} + 1`,
            updatedAt: new Date(),
          },
        })
        .returning();

      res.status(existing ? 200 : 201).json(mapLessonRow(row));
    } catch (err) {
      if (isTokenError(err)) {
        res.status(401).json({ error: "Invalid token" });
        return;
      }
      sendRouteError(res, err, "[Server] POST lesson generate failed");
    }
  },
);

app.post("/api/lessons/:id/audio", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const claims = await verifyClerkToken(req.headers.authorization);
    const lessonId = req.params.id;
    if (!LESSON_ID_RE.test(lessonId)) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: "Invalid lesson id" });
      return;
    }

    const [row] = await db
      .select()
      .from(lessonScripts)
      .where(eq(lessonScripts.id, lessonId))
      .limit(1);

    if (!row) {
      res.status(404).json({ error: "Lesson not found" });
      return;
    }

    const access = await getCourseAccess(row.courseId, claims.sub);
    if (access.status === "not_found") {
      res.status(404).json({ error: "Course not found" });
      return;
    }
    if (access.status === "forbidden") {
      res.status(403).json({ error: "This course is private" });
      return;
    }

    const source = resolveLessonSource(
      access.course,
      row.chapterIndex,
      row.subtopicIndex,
    );
    if (
      !source ||
      row.sourceHash !==
        lessonHash(access.course, source.chapter, source.subtopic)
    ) {
      res
        .status(409)
        .json({ error: "Lesson needs regeneration", code: "lesson_stale" });
      return;
    }

    const script = readLessonScript(row);
    if (script.slides.length === 0) {
      res.status(422).json({ error: "Lesson script is empty" });
      return;
    }

    const cachedAudio = new Map(
      (Array.isArray(row.audio) ? row.audio : []).map((clip) => [
        clip.slideId,
        clip,
      ]),
    );
    const complete = script.slides.every(
      (slide) => !!cachedAudio.get(slide.id)?.url,
    );

    if (complete) {
      if (row.status !== "audio_ready") {
        await db
          .update(lessonScripts)
          .set({ status: "audio_ready", updatedAt: new Date() })
          .where(eq(lessonScripts.id, row.id));
      }
      res.json(mapLessonRow({ ...row, status: "audio_ready" }));
      return;
    }

    const { modelRef, apiKey } = aiRequestOptions(req);
    const geminiKey = modelRef.startsWith("gemini::") ? apiKey : undefined;
    const ai = getGemini(geminiKey);
    const voice = row.voice || TTS_VOICE;
    const clips: (LessonAudioClip | undefined)[] = script.slides.map(
      (slide) => {
        const cached = cachedAudio.get(slide.id);
        return cached?.url ? cached : undefined;
      },
    );
    const pending = script.slides
      .map((slide, index) => ({ slide, index }))
      .filter(({ index }) => !clips[index]);
    let cursor = 0;
    let failed = 0;

    const worker = async () => {
      while (cursor < pending.length) {
        const current = pending[cursor];
        cursor += 1;
        if (!current) return;
        const { slide, index } = current;

        try {
          const speech = await generateSpeechWithRetry(
            ai,
            slide.narration,
            voice,
          );
          const wav = pcmToWav(speech.base64, {
            sampleRate: pcmRateFromMime(speech.mimeType),
          });
          const uploadedUrl = await uploadToCloudinary(
            wav.base64,
            "audio/wav",
            { resourceType: "video" },
          );
          clips[index] = {
            slideId: slide.id,
            url: lessonAudioDeliveryUrl(uploadedUrl),
            durationMs: wav.durationMs,
            mimeType: "audio/mpeg",
          };
        } catch (err) {
          failed += 1;
          console.warn(
            `[Server] Lesson audio failed for ${row.id}/${slide.id}:`,
            err instanceof Error ? err.message : err,
          );
        }
      }
    };

    await Promise.all(
      Array.from({ length: Math.min(3, pending.length) }, () => worker()),
    );

    const audio = clips.filter(
      (clip): clip is LessonAudioClip => clip !== undefined,
    );
    const status: LessonStatus = failed === 0 ? "audio_ready" : "script_ready";
    await db
      .update(lessonScripts)
      .set({ audio, status, updatedAt: new Date() })
      .where(eq(lessonScripts.id, row.id));

    const payload = mapLessonRow({ ...row, audio, status });
    if (failed > 0) {
      payload.audioError =
        failed === script.slides.length
          ? "Narration is unavailable right now. You can still read every slide."
          : `Narration is unavailable for ${failed} of ${script.slides.length} slides.`;
    }
    res.json(payload);
  } catch (err) {
    if (isTokenError(err)) {
      res.status(401).json({ error: "Invalid token" });
      return;
    }
    sendRouteError(res, err, "[Server] POST lesson audio failed");
  }
});

function aiModelHeaders(overrideRef?: string): Record<string, string> {
  let selected =

  }
  return headers;
}

function resolveDevServerBase(): string | null {
  const hostUri = Constants.expoConfig?.hostUri;
  if (!hostUri) return null;

  let host = hostUri.includes("://") ? hostUri.split("://")[1] : hostUri;
  host = host.split(":")[0].replace(/[\[\]]/g, "");
  if (!host) return null;

  if (
    Platform.OS === "android" &&
    (host === "localhost" || host === "127.0.0.1")
  ) {
    host = "10.0.2.2";
  }

  return `http://${host}:3001`;
}

export class ApiError extends Error {

    this.name = "ApiError";
    this.status = status;
    this.code = code;
  }
}

function mergeSignals(
  existing?: AbortSignal | null,
  timeout?: AbortSignal | null,
): AbortSignal | undefined {
  if (!timeout) return existing ?? undefined;
  if (!existing) return timeout ?? undefined;
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const onAbort = () => controller.abort();
  existing.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });
  timeout.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });
  return controller.signal;
}

export function friendlyError(
  err: unknown,
  fallback = "Something went wrong. Please try again.",
): string {
  if (err instanceof TypeError && err.message === "Network request failed") {
    return "Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.";
  }
  if (err instanceof Error && err.message) return err.message;
  return fallback;
}

function formatLogArg(value: unknown): string {
  if (value instanceof Error) {
    return `${value.name}: ${value.message}${value.stack ? `\n${value.stack}` : ""}`;
  }
  if (typeof value === "string") return value;
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(value);
  } catch {
    return String(value);
  }
}

// Mirror console.error/warn into a file so real server errors survive after the
// terminal scrolls away (previously only startup output was ever captured).
for (const level of ["error", "warn"] as const) {
  const original = console[level].bind(console);
  console[level] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
    original(...args);
    try {
      const line = `[${new Date().toISOString()}] ${level.toUpperCase()} ${args
        .map(formatLogArg)
        .join(" ")}\n`;
      fs.appendFileSync(SERVER_LOG_FILE, line);

      // logging must never break a request
    }
  };

This is an [Expo](https://expo.dev) project created with [`create-expo-app`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/create-expo-app).

In the output, you'll find options to open the app in a

## Get a fresh project

```bash

## Deployment

See `docs/DEPLOY.md` for the full step-by-step production deployment guide (accounts, EAS setup, signing credentials, Fly.io secrets, acceptance checklist).

### App builds (EAS)

Profiles live in `eas.json`: `development` (dev-client), `preview` (internal test builds), `production` (store: AAB + App Store). CI runs lint, typechecks, and a web export on every PR; a tag `v*` (or manual `workflow_dispatch`) triggers internal iOS + Android preview builds via `.github/workflows/eas-build.yml`.

One-time setup (requires an Expo account �?" run locally, never in CI):

```bash
npx eas init        # links the project, writes extra.eas.projectId into app.json
npx eas build:configure
npx eas credentials # iOS signing certs/profiles + Android keystore
```

Set the production envs in EAS (dashboard �+' project �+' Environment variables or `eas env`):

| Variable | Value |
|---|---|
| `EXPO_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` | live Clerk publishable key (`pk_live_...`) |
| `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL` | production API origin, e.g. `https://api.your-domain.com` |

`.env.example` mirrors what CI needs. EAS store submissions: `eas submit --platform all --profile production`.

### Server (Fly.io)

The server is an Express app run via `tsx` (same as `npm run start:server`). `fly.toml` + `Dockerfile` are checked in.

```bash
# one-time: create the app (needs flyctl + Fly account); do NOT run fly launch
fly apps create ezeay-api
fly volume create uploads --region iad --size 1   # before first deploy; must match fly.toml region

# env & secrets (never in git)
fly secrets set NEON_DATABASE_URL=... CLERK_SECRET_KEY=... GEMINI_API_KEY=...
fly secrets set OPENAI_API_KEY=... ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... OPENROUTER_API_KEY=...
fly secrets set CORS_ORIGINS=https://app.your-domain.com GLOBAL_RATE_LIMIT=300 STRICT_RATE_LIMIT=20
fly secrets set STUDY_FETCH_ALLOWLIST=
fly secrets list

fly deploy            # builds + deploys; uploads persist on the "uploads" volume
fly volumes snapshot list # backup the uploads volume as needed
```

Notes:
- User-uploaded study files persist at `/app/server/uploads` on a Fly volume (survives redeploys). Cloudinary is not wired into the client.
- Health check hits `/api/health`.
- Deploy with `NODE_ENV=production` (already set in `fly.toml`) so CORS is locked to `CORS_ORIGINS` only.

// --- Schedule planner suggestions ---

function sanitizeScheduleTasks(value: unknown): {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  time?: string;
  done: boolean;
}[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  const out: { id: string; title: string; time?: string; done: boolean }[] = [];
  for (const item of value) {
    if (!item || typeof item !== "object") continue;
    const o = item as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (typeof o.id !== "string" || !o.id) continue;
    if (typeof o.title !== "string" || !o.title.trim()) continue;
    const time =
      typeof o.time === "string" && /^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(o.time)
        ? o.time
        : undefined;
    out.push({
      id: o.id.slice(0, 64),
      title: o.title.trim().slice(0, 120),
      time,
      done: o.done === true,
    });
    if (out.length >= 25) break;
  }
  return out;
}

function normalizeScheduleSuggestions(
  result: unknown,
  pool: { id: string }[],
): { id: string; reason: string }[] {
  if (!result || typeof result !== "object") return [];
  const raw = (result as Record<string, unknown>).suggestions;
  if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
  const poolIds = new Set(pool.map((t) => t.id));
  const out: { id: string; reason: string }[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const s of raw) {
    if (!s || typeof s !== "object") continue;
    const o = s as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (typeof o.id !== "string" || !poolIds.has(o.id)) continue;
    if (seen.has(o.id)) continue;
    seen.add(o.id);
    out.push({
      id: o.id,
      reason:
        typeof o.reason === "string" && o.reason
          ? o.reason.slice(0, 160)
          : "Suggested",
    });
    if (out.length >= 5) break;
  }
  return out;
}

app.post("/api/schedule/suggest", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    await verifyClerkToken(req.headers.authorization);
    const { date, tasks } = req.body;

    const cleanTasks = sanitizeScheduleTasks(tasks);
    if (cleanTasks.length === 0) {
      res.status(400).json({ error: "No tasks provided" });
      return;
    }

    const { system } = buildScheduleSuggestPrompt({
      date:
        typeof date === "string" && date
          ? date.slice(0, 10)
          : new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      tasks: cleanTasks,
    });

    const ai = aiRequestOptions(req);
    let suggestions: { id: string; reason: string }[];
    try {
      const result = await generateJsonContent<{ suggestions?: unknown }>(
        ai.modelRef,
        `${system}\n\nReturn ONLY valid JSON matching the requested structure. Do NOT include any markdown code fences. Return raw JSON only.`,
        ai.apiKey,
      );
      suggestions = normalizeScheduleSuggestions(result, cleanTasks);
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      if (message.includes("no parseable JSON")) {
        const label = getModelOption(ai.modelRef)?.label ?? ai.modelRef;
        res.status(422).json({
          error: `"${label}" returned no usable suggestions. Please try again or switch to a more reliable model.`,
        });
        return;
      }
      throw err;
    }

    if (suggestions.length === 0) {
      const label = getModelOption(ai.modelRef)?.label ?? ai.modelRef;
      res.status(422).json({
        error: `"${label}" returned no usable suggestions. Please try again or switch to a more reliable model.`,
      });
      return;
    }

    res.json({ suggestions });
  } catch (err) {
    sendRouteError(res, err, "[Server] POST /api/schedule/suggest failed");
  }
});

const PORT = parseInt(process.env.PORT || "3001", 10);

export { app };

if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "test" && process.env.NO_LISTEN !== "1") {
  app.listen(PORT, () => {
    console.log(`[Server] Running on http://localhost:${PORT}`);
    console.log(`[Server] DB host: ${DB_HOST}`);
  });
}

import { TokenCache } from '@clerk/expo';
import * as SecureStore from 'expo-secure-store';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';

export const tokenCache: TokenCache = {
  async getToken(key: string): Promise<string | undefined | null> {
    try {
      if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
          return window.localStorage.getItem(key);
        }
        return null;
      }
      return await SecureStore.getItemAsync(key);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Clerk Token Cache - Get Error:', err);
      return null;
    }
  },

  async saveToken(key: string, value: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
          window.localStorage.setItem(key, value);
        }
        return;
      }
      await SecureStore.setItemAsync(key, value);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Clerk Token Cache - Save Error:', err);
    }
  },

  clearToken(key: string): void {
    try {
      if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
          window.localStorage.removeItem(key);
        }
        return;
      }
      SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(key).catch((err) => {
        console.error('Clerk Token Cache - Async Delete Error:', err);
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Clerk Token Cache - Clear Error:', err);
    }
  }
};


```

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { test } from "node:test";
import type { LessonAudioClip, LessonSlide } from "../../types/lesson";
import {
  clampSlideIndex,
  equationAspectRatio,
  findAudioClip,
  formatTimecode,
  hasAudioForSlide,
  isAudioComplete,
  narrationEndAction,
  prepareEquationSvg,
} from "./player";

const audio: LessonAudioClip[] = [
  { slideId: "s1", url: "https://example.com/s1.mp3", durationMs: 1200 },
  { slideId: "s2", url: "", durationMs: 900 },
];

const checkpointSlide: Pick<LessonSlide, "checkpoint"> = {
  checkpoint: {
    question: "What is 2 + 2?",
    options: ["3", "4"],
    correct: 1,
    explanation: "Four.",
  },
};

test("clampSlideIndex keeps indexes inside the slide range", () => {
  assert.equal(clampSlideIndex(-3, 5), 0);
  assert.equal(clampSlideIndex(2.4, 5), 2);
  assert.equal(clampSlideIndex(9, 5), 4);
  assert.equal(clampSlideIndex(Number.NaN, 5), 0);
  assert.equal(clampSlideIndex(1, 0), 0);
});

test("audio helpers ignore clips without a url", () => {
  assert.equal(hasAudioForSlide(audio, "s1"), true);
  assert.equal(hasAudioForSlide(audio, "s2"), false);
  assert.equal(hasAudioForSlide(audio, "s3"), false);
  assert.deepEqual(findAudioClip(audio, "s1"), audio[0]);
  assert.equal(findAudioClip(audio, "s2"), null);
});

test("isAudioComplete requires every slide to have narration", () => {
  assert.equal(isAudioComplete([], []), false);
  assert.equal(isAudioComplete([{ id: "s1" }], audio), true);
  assert.equal(
    isAudioComplete([{ id: "s1" }, { id: "s2" }], audio),
    false,
  );
});

test("formatTimecode renders minute and second timecodes", () => {
  assert.equal(formatTimecode(0), "0:00");
  assert.equal(formatTimecode(-100), "0:00");
  assert.equal(formatTimecode(999), "0:00");
  assert.equal(formatTimecode(61_000), "1:01");
  assert.equal(formatTimecode(125_500), "2:05");
  assert.equal(formatTimecode(Number.NaN), "0:00");
});

test("narrationEndAction prioritizes checkpoints and finishes the deck", () => {
  assert.equal(narrationEndAction(checkpointSlide, true), "checkpoint");
  assert.equal(narrationEndAction(checkpointSlide, false), "checkpoint");
  assert.equal(narrationEndAction({}, false), "advance");
  assert.equal(narrationEndAction({}, true), "finish");
});

test("prepareEquationSvg strips fixed dimensions and theme colors", () => {
  const svg =
    '<svg width="12ex" height="4ex" style="vertical-align: -1ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 0 100 40"><defs><path id="p" fill="currentColor"/></defs><use href="#p"/></svg>';
  const prepared = prepareEquationSvg(svg, "#111827");

  assert.doesNotMatch(prepared, /width="12ex"/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(prepared, /height="4ex"/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(prepared, /style=/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(prepared, /role=/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(prepared, /focusable=/);
  assert.match(prepared, /viewBox="0 0 100 40"/);
  assert.match(prepared, /fill="#111827"/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(prepared, /currentColor/);
});

test("prepareEquationSvg falls back when the color is blank", () => {
  assert.match(
    prepareEquationSvg('<svg viewBox="0 0 1 1"><path fill="currentColor"/></svg>', "  "),
    /fill="#000000"/,
  );
});

test("equationAspectRatio reads valid viewBox dimensions", () => {
  assert.equal(equationAspectRatio('<svg viewBox="0 0 120 60">'), 2);
  assert.equal(equationAspectRatio('<svg viewBox="0,0,90,30">'), 3);
  assert.equal(equationAspectRatio('<svg viewBox="0 0 0 30">'), null);
  assert.equal(equationAspectRatio('<svg width="10">'), null);
  assert.equal(equationAspectRatio('<svg viewBox="0 0 nope 30">'), null);
});

```

**Output:**
```
});

type CloudinaryResourceType = "image" | "video";

interface CloudinaryUploadOptions {
  resourceType?: CloudinaryResourceType;
}

async function uploadToCloudinary(
  base64: string,
  mimeType = "image/png",
  options: CloudinaryUploadOptions = {},
): Promise<string> {
  const cloudName = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME;
  const resourceType = options.resourceType ?? "image";
  const imagePreset = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET;
  const apiKey = process.env.CLOUDINARY_API_KEY;
  const apiSecret = process.env.CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET;

  if (!cloudName) {
    throw new Error("Cloudinary cloud name is not configured");
  }

  let uploadPreset =
    resourceType === "video"
      ? process.env.CLOUDINARY_AUDIO_UPLOAD_PRESET || ""
      : imagePreset || "";

  if (!uploadPreset && !(apiKey && apiSecret) && resourceType === "video") {
    uploadPreset = imagePreset || "";
  }

  const formData = new URLSearchParams();
  formData.append("file", `data:${mimeType};base64,${base64}`);

  if (uploadPreset) {
    formData.append("upload_preset", uploadPreset);
  } else if (apiKey && apiSecret) {
    const timestamp = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000).toString();
    const signature = crypto
      .createHash("sha1")
      .update(`timestamp=${timestamp}${apiSecret}`)
      .digest("hex");
    formData.append("api_key", apiKey);
    formData.append("timestamp", timestamp);
    formData.append("signature", signature);
  } else {
    throw new Error("Cloudinary upload is not configured");
  }

  const response = await fetch(
    `https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/${cloudName}/${resourceType}/upload`,
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
      body: formData.toString(),
    },
  );

  const data = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as {
    secure_url?: string;
    error?: { message?: string };
  } | null;

  if (!response.ok || !data?.secure_url) {
    const err = new Error(
      data?.error?.message || `Cloudinary upload failed (${response.status})`,
    );
    (err as { statusCode?: number }).statusCode = 502;
    (err as { expose?: boolean }).expose = true;
    throw err;
  }

  return data.secure_url;
}

```

# Full Testing Guide — Animated Lessons

Use a **native dev build** for complete coverage. Web is good for layout, routes, and caching, but browser autoplay rules apply.

## 1. One-time setup

From the repo root:

```powershell
node -v                  # should be 22.x
npm install
npm install --prefix server
```

Confirm `.env` contains at least:

```text
EXPO_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
CLERK_SECRET_KEY
NEON_DATABASE_URL
GEMINI_API_KEY
EXPO_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME
EXPO_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET
```

`GEMINI_API_KEY` is required for both lesson generation and narration. Cloudinary is required for narration upload.

> Do not run `drizzle/0010_sweet_moira_mactaggert.sql` against your current DB. The `lesson_scripts` table should already exist.

## 2. Run automated tests first

```powershell
npm run typecheck
npm run test:lesson
npm run test:server
npm run lint
npm run export:web
```

Expected:

- Typecheck: no output/errors.
- Lesson tests: **8 passing**.
- Server tests: **38 passing**.
- Lint: **0 errors**. Existing warnings are acceptable for now.
- Export: completes with `Exported: dist`.

## 3. Start the app and server

Use two terminals.

**Terminal 1 — API server**

```powershell
npm run start:server
```

Expected:

```text
[Server] Running on http://localhost:3001
[Server] DB host: ...
```

**Terminal 2 — Expo app**

```powershell
npm start
```

Then press:

- `a` for Android emulator/device
- `i` for iOS simulator, macOS only
- `w` for web

If you do not have the development build installed:

```powershell
npm run android
# or on macOS:
npm run ios
```

For a physical phone:

- Phone and PC must be on the same Wi-Fi.
- Allow port `3001` through Windows Firewall.
- Do not use Expo tunnel for local API testing, because the API URL is derived from the Expo host.
- Android emulator automatically maps localhost to `10.0.2.2`.

## 4. Prepare test content

1. Sign in.
2. Go to **Quests**.
3. Tap **Generate AI Course**.
4. Enter a specific topic, for example:
   - `Master fractions and equivalent fractions`
   - `How photosynthesis works step by step`
5. Tap **GENERATE MY COURSE**.
6. Wait for the course.
7. Tap **START**.
8. Open a chapter.
9. Tap a subtopic to open its content.

The **Watch animated lesson** button appears below the subtopic content and above the quiz section.

For visual variety:

- Use a math topic to exercise equation slides.
- Use a process/system topic to exercise diagram slides.

## 5. Happy-path lesson test

1. Tap **Watch animated lesson**.
2. First time for that subtopic, expect:
   - “Opening your lesson...”
   - then “Building your lesson...”
   - then slide 1.
3. Generation can take roughly **30–90 seconds**.
4. Check the header:
   - Back button
   - “Animated lesson” eyebrow
   - Lesson title
5. Verify the stage shows:
   - Slide count, e.g. `Slide 1 of 6`
   - Reveal label
   - The rendered visual
6. Tap **Next slide** and **Previous**.
7. Verify the progress bar and counter update.

## 6. Test every slide visual type

A generated lesson may not contain every visual kind. To cover them:

- Generate several courses/topics.
- Or inspect the `lesson_scripts` row after generation.

For each visual found, verify:

- **Title:** centered title, subtitle, accent rule.
- **Bullets:** numbered rows, readable wrapping.
- **Equation:** SVG renders in the current theme color; no clipped edges.
- **Diagram:** nodes, labels, dashed edges; labels do not clip at stage edges.
- **Callout:** correct icon/color for key, tip, warning.
- **Reveal animation:** fade/write/draw/none behaves and does not flicker.

Also test:

- Light and dark theme.
- Narrow phone width.
- Wide web/tablet width.

## 7. Test narration

1. Find a slide showing **Create on play**.
2. Tap the play button.
3. Expect:
   - Spinner and “Creating narration...”
   - Server generates narration for all slides.
   - First generation may take **30–90 seconds**.
4. On native, it should auto-play after generation.
5. On web, browser autoplay may require you to tap play a second time.
6. Verify:
   - Timecode advances.
   - Progress bar advances.
   - Pause/resume works.
   - Replay restarts at `0:00`.
   - Duration displays correctly.
7. On iOS, enable the silent switch and verify narration still plays.
8. Let narration finish on a non-checkpoint slide: it should auto-advance and auto-play the next slide.
9. Let narration finish on a checkpoint slide: it should stop and scroll to the checkpoint.
10. Let narration finish on the last slide: the completion card should appear.

Reopen the lesson and verify:

- It opens immediately without rebuilding.
- Previously generated slides show **Audio ready**.
- Narration does not regenerate.

## 8. Test checkpoints

Navigate to a slide containing a checkpoint.

1. Before answering, verify **Next slide** is disabled and the hint appears.
2. Choose a wrong answer.
3. Tap **Check answer**.
4. Expect:
   - Warning haptic on native.
   - Red/warning feedback.
   - Ability to choose another answer.
5. Choose the correct answer.
6. Tap **Check answer**.
7. Expect success haptic, success styling, explanation, and **Continue**.
8. Tap **Continue**.
9. Verify it moves forward, or finishes if it is the last slide.
10. Return to the checkpoint:
    - It should remain solved.
    - Continue should be available immediately.

## 9. Test the explain sheet

On any slide, tap:

- **Simpler**
- **Example**
- **Why**

Verify:

1. Bottom sheet opens.
2. Spinner shows while loading.
3. Explanation appears.
4. Tapping another action while loading replaces the request correctly.
5. Reopening a cached action is instant.
6. Close works via the X button and backdrop.
7. Stop the server, then request a new explanation:
   - Friendly error appears.
   - **Try again** is shown.
8. Restart the server and retry.

## 10. Test completion and replay

1. Finish the final slide using **Finish lesson** or narration completion.
2. Verify:
   - “Lesson complete”
   - Slide count
   - **Replay** and **Done**
3. Tap **Replay**:
   - Returns to slide 1.
   - Checkpoints reset.
   - Audio starts again.
4. Tap **Done** or header back:
   - Returns to the chapter screen.

## 11. Test deep links and error states

On web, open the lesson and copy the URL. It should look like:

```text
http://localhost:8081/<courseId>/lesson/<chapterIndex>/<subtopicIndex>
```

Indices are zero-based.

Test:

1. Refresh the lesson URL while signed in:
   - Lesson should reload correctly.
2. Open it in a fresh tab:
   - Header back should fall back to the chapter or tabs.
3. Change indices to invalid values, e.g. `/lesson/999/999`:
   - Expect “Couldn't open this lesson”.
   - Try again and Go back should work.
4. Stop the API server and reload:
   - Expect a network/server error, not a blank screen.
5. Restart the server and tap **Try again**.

## 12. Test caching in the database

Optional but useful:

```powershell
npm run db:studio
```

Open `lesson_scripts` and verify:

- One row per course/chapter/subtopic.
- `script` contains the slides.
- `audio` contains one clip per slide after TTS.
- `status` goes from `script_ready` to `audio_ready`.
- Reopening the lesson does not create duplicate rows.
- Generating audio again does not re-upload existing clips.

Explain responses are cached only for the current player session, not persisted across reloads.

## 13. Platform coverage

**iOS**

- Audio playback, pause/resume, replay.
- Silent switch behavior.
- Haptics on correct/wrong/completion.
- Safe-area spacing at top and bottom.

**Android**

- Hardware back button.
- Audio playback.
- Haptics if enabled.
- Back behavior from lesson and explain modal.

**Web**

- Wide chapter layout displays the lesson button in the reading pane.
- Lesson player max width and scrolling.
- Explain sheet scrolling with long text.
- Refresh/deep link.
- Remember second play tap after first narration generation.

## 14. Troubleshooting

- **“Can't reach the server”**: confirm `npm run start:server`, port `3001`, same Wi-Fi, firewall.
- **Lesson generation fails**: choose Gemini in **Settings → AI Model**; check `GEMINI_API_KEY`; inspect `server.log`.
- **Narration unavailable**: check `GEMINI_API_KEY` and Cloudinary settings; inspect `server.log`. Slides should remain usable.
- **Lesson button missing**: open a subtopic first; the button appears only when subtopic content is active.
- **Lesson rebuilds every time**: DB persistence or source hash may be failing; inspect `server.log` and `lesson_scripts`.
- **Web does not autoplay after generation**: expected browser behavior; tap play again.

## Definition of done

The feature passes when:

- Chapter entry opens the correct lesson.
- Slides, equations, diagrams, and callouts render correctly.
- Narration creates once, persists, plays, pauses, replays, and auto-advances.
- Checkpoints gate Next and remain solved within the session.
- Explain requests work, cache, and show friendly errors.
- Completion and replay work.
- Reopening the lesson is instant and does not regenerate.
- Auth, loading, empty, network, and invalid-route states are handled.
- Typecheck, lesson tests, server tests, lint, and web export all pass.
